content: {"praised":["Atmosphere created by director Alex Proyas is compelling.","Nicholas Cage delivers strong, engaging performance.","Thoughtful, mind‑bending plot invites personal interpretation.","Visuals and music enhance suspenseful tone.","Story blends science fiction with emotional family drama."],"criticized":["Script is poorly written and confusing.","Characters lack development and change.","Story leads to inevitable destruction with no agency.","Plot feels wasted and unfulfilling.","Tone shifts abruptly, undermining coherence."]}
